tool_input.description: Debug test to see actual metric scores

tool_input.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
# Extract test data from both test files
import re

with open('packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.test.js', 'r') as f:
    index_test = f.read()

with open('packages/frai-core/src/eval/tone-policy.test.js', 'r') as f:
    tone_test = f.read()

# Find runEvaluations calls
index_match = re.search(r'runEvaluations\({[^}]*outputs:\s*(\[[^\]]*\])[^}]*references:\s*(\[[^\]]*\])', index_test)
tone_match = re.search(r'runEvaluations\({[^}]*outputs:\s*(\[[^\]]*\])[^}]*references:\s*(\[[^\]]*\])', tone_test)

if index_match and tone_match:
    index_outputs = index_match.group(1)
    index_refs = index_match.group(2)
    tone_outputs = tone_match.group(1)
    tone_refs = tone_match.group(2)
    
    print("Index test outputs:", repr(index_outputs))
    print("Tone test outputs:", repr(tone_outputs))
    print("Match?", index_outputs == tone_outputs)
    print()
    print("Index test references:", repr(index_refs))
    print("Tone test references:", repr(tone_refs))
    print("Match?", index_refs == tone_refs)
EOF
